title: Lesson 1 Quiz: What Day Trading Is — and Is Not

questions.text: Which of the following best describes day trading?
options: Holding positions for weeks to capture medium-term trends
Opening and closing all positions within the same trading day with zero overnight exposure
Buying stocks for dividend income over 5-20 years
Using only fundamental analysis to ignore daily price swings
questions.explanation: Day trading requires all trades to be closed before market close, avoiding overnight risk.

questions.text: A day trader may hold a position overnight if they expect the trade to become profitable the next day.
questions.explanation: Day trading requires closing all positions before the session ends to avoid overnight news risk.
